source.title: DNA Barcoding of Teleost Fishes from North Luzon, Philippines: A Dataset for Ichthyofaunal Diversity Assessment
source.sourceCoverageNote: The paper is cross-regional: Aurora and Zambales are Region III; Cagayan belongs to a different rollout phase. Keep sites and records assigned only by their documented collection locality, not by the paper title or a broad North Luzon label.
source.reportedDataAvailability: The article reports GenBank sequence accessions and specimen metadata in supplementary Tables S1a-S1c, including locality, depth, date and method.

accessReview.publisherArticlePage: Publisher-indexed article text and abstract reviewed; a live open attempt redirected to an inaccessible authorization endpoint during the 2026-10-24 recheck.
accessReview.supplementaryWorkbook: Not downloaded or transcribed. Its contents and any data-specific terms have not been independently reviewed.
accessReview.genbankRecords: Accession records were not fetched or crosswalked in this batch.
accessReview.reuseDisposition: The article license permits noncommercial sharing of unadapted material but excludes adapted material. No species table or supplementary row is copied into this review. Obtain rights-holder clarification before creating or publishing an adapted species/locality dataset from the article tables.

evidenceLimits: The field work occurred in 2023; it does not establish present-day occurrence.
Freshwater river collections and marine market/landing-site samples have different locality meanings. Market or landing location alone is not a verified capture locality.
The reported 323 taxa are source-level identification results, not 323 Region III records or an exhaustive provincial checklist.
No specimen-level names, coordinates, site-to-region assignments, geometry, diet, catchability, abundance, or safety facts were reviewed here.
No source-derived rows were added to the app or regional species projections.
nextStep: Check whether GenBank records and their individual metadata can be reviewed under their own access terms without adapting the CC BY-NC-ND article tables; separately seek rights-holder clarification for table reuse. Then continue Central Luzon source discovery in Bulacan and Tarlac and obtain site-specific evidence for Aurora and Zambales.
